modules.title: Introduction to Peace and Conflict Resolution
modules.html:
Causes of conflict in society and methods of resolving conflict peacefully. This section covers introduction to peace and conflict resolution.

Key points

  • Conflict resolution through a neutral third party whose decision is binding is _____. — Arbitration.
  • Which of the following can lead to inter-communal conflict — Resource control and land disputes.
  • Inter-communal conflict can be caused by _____. — Land disputes.
  • Which of these is a way of resolving conflict — Mediation.
  • Which of the following is an example of an inter-communal conflict in Nigeria — The Ife-Modakeke crisis.

Worked examples

Q: Conflict resolution through a neutral third party whose decision is binding is _____.
A: Arbitration — In arbitration, an independent person (the arbitrator) makes a final, legally binding decision on a dispute.

Q: Which of the following can lead to inter-communal conflict?
A: Resource control and land disputes — Conflicts between communities often arise over ownership of land, boundary disputes, or control of natural resources.

quiz.q: Conflict resolution through a neutral third party whose decision is binding is _____.
quiz.solution: In arbitration, an independent person (the arbitrator) makes a final, legally binding decision on a dispute.

quiz.q: Which of the following can lead to inter-communal conflict?
quiz.solution: Conflicts between communities often arise over ownership of land, boundary disputes, or control of natural resources.

quiz.q: Inter-communal conflict can be caused by _____.
quiz.solution: Disputes over land ownership and boundaries are the most frequent causes of violent clashes between neighboring communities.

quiz.q: Which of these is a way of resolving conflict?
quiz.solution: Mediation involves a neutral third party helping the disputing sides reach a mutually acceptable agreement.

quiz.q: Which of the following is an example of an inter-communal conflict in Nigeria?
quiz.solution: The Ife-Modakeke crisis is a classic example of long-standing conflict between two neighboring communities in Osun State.

quiz.q: Voter apathy refers to _____.
options: Lack of interest in participating in elections
quiz.solution: Voter apathy is a lack of interest among citizens in participating in the electoral process, often shown by low voter turnout.

quiz.q: The act of treating someone unfairly because they have a certain disease or condition is called _____.
quiz.solution: Stigmatization involves social disapproval and discrimination against individuals based on perceived characteristics, such as being HIV positive.

quiz.q: A situation where there is no war, disturbance, or fear in a society is _____.
quiz.solution: Peace is a state of harmony characterized by the lack of violent conflict and the freedom from fear of violence.

quiz.q: Which of these is a way of preventing HIV/AIDS?
options: Using the same toothbrush as an infected person
quiz.solution: Abstinence from sexual intercourse is the most effective way to prevent the sexual transmission of HIV.

quiz.q: Responsible followership involves _____.
quiz.solution: Responsible followers contribute to the success of a leader by being law-abiding and offering honest feedback.

quiz.q: The Child Rights Act was passed in Nigeria in _____.
quiz.solution: The Child Rights Act (2003) is the law that guarantees the rights of all children in Nigeria and provides for their protection.

quiz.q: The act of giving or receiving money to influence a public official is _____.
quiz.solution: Bribery is a form of corruption that undermines the integrity of public institutions.

quiz.q: A situation where a person is treated unfairly because they are living with HIV/AIDS is known as _____.
quiz.solution: Stigmatization is the social disapproval and discrimination against people based on their health status, which discourages testing and treatment.

quiz.q: Which of the following is a skill for youth empowerment?
quiz.solution: Communication skills are essential soft skills that empower youths to interact, negotiate, and succeed in the professional world.

quiz.q: Which of the following is a duty of a citizen?
quiz.solution: Payment of taxes is an obligatory duty of every citizen to enable the government to provide public services.

quiz.q: The yellow light on a traffic signal means _____.
quiz.solution: Amber (Yellow) signifies that the light is about to change to red, advising motorists to slow down and prepare to stop.
